title: Vanishing directional-derivative integrals give translation invariance of smooth test-function integrals
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, ν a Borel measure on ℝ^P = Euclid P with ν(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P, and v ∈ ℝ^P. Assume ∫Dφ(y)[v] dν(y) = 0 (the Bochner integral of y ↦ fderiv ℝ φ y v) for every C^∞ function φ : ℝ^P → ℝ with compact support. Then ∫φ(v + y) dν(y) = ∫φ(y) dν(y) for every C^∞ function φ : ℝ^P → ℝ with compact support.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (v : Euclid P), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → ν K < ∞) → (∀ φ : Euclid P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ → HasCompactSupport φ → ∫ y, fderiv ℝ φ y v ∂ν = 0) → ∀ φ : Euclid P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ → HasCompactSupport φ → ∫ y, φ (v + y) ∂ν = ∫ y, φ y ∂ν
